##### Project general facts

OM Club House is a premium-class residential complex by Avalon Development Bali, a company with extensive construction expertise and a growing international presence. This intimate project features a curated collection of modern apartments in Canggu’s most desirable Berawa district, designed for both sophisticated living and high-yield investment. Managed by the experienced Ribas Hotels Group, the development combines architectural refinement with professional hospitality management, offering investors a guaranteed minimum return and a seamless ownership experience.

Residents are welcomed into a world of relaxation and inspiration. The rooftop terrace transforms into a true resort, featuring an infinity pool, a fully equipped barbecue space, a rooftop bar and lounge, and an open-air cinema for unforgettable evenings. Tropical rain showers, a rooftop garden for yoga, and cozy lounge areas complete this extraordinary amenity offering, creating the perfect setting to enjoy Bali’s legendary sunsets in style and serenity.

Each apartment at OM Club House is crafted with meticulous attention to detail and contemporary design. Modern one- and two-bedroom layouts feature panoramic glazing, premium finishes, and select units with private pools, jacuzzis, or inner courtyards. Interiors include fully equipped kitchens, audio systems, spacious wardrobes, and high-quality homogeneous tile flooring. Constructed with reinforced concrete, black aluminum YKK glazing, and tempered glass railings, every residence reflects an uncompromising commitment to quality, comfort, and timeless elegance.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the prestigious Berawa district of Canggu within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents at the heart of Bali’s most dynamic and sought-after coastal community. Berawa is renowned for its vibrant energy, world-class dining, boutique shopping, and some of the island’s most iconic beach clubs. The area perfectly balances modern convenience with tropical charm, attracting a discerning international crowd seeking both lifestyle and investment potential.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and lifestyle offerings. Just moments from Berawa Beach, residents enjoy easy access to golden sands and legendary surf breaks, while a wealth of cafes, fitness centers, and cultural attractions are within easy reach. The neighborhood’s well-developed infrastructure and growing reputation as a premier destination make it highly desirable for both short-term visitors and long-term residents.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the essence of contemporary island living, Canggu delivers an unmatched experience. Its unique blend of coastal beauty, thriving community, and world-class amenities has made it one of Bali’s most sought-after addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of tropical living, vibrant, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
